Name: Vision
Question: Where are we going?
Definition: The shared, aspirational future state and strategic direction.
Case outputs: Vision statement; strategic intent; transformation North Star; policy alignment; transformation portfolio; program structure
Template application: Chapters 6 and 14: vision, principles, objectives, business case; registers: principles, kpis

Name: Value
Question: What meaningful value are we creating?
Definition: Tangible, measurable benefits for customers, employees, organisations, ecosystems and society.
Case outputs: Value proposition; value tree; capability and value map; platform strategy; product and service design; process and value-stream transformation; value metrics
Template application: Chapters 10 to 13: capabilities, value stream, data, applications, technology; registers: capabilities, value_stream, components

Name: Victory
Question: What tangible outcomes and momentum have we achieved?
Definition: Measurable milestones and small wins that build confidence, trust, adoption and momentum.
Case outputs: Change and adoption plan; new practices; project execution plan; milestone and KPI dashboard; benefits realisation; victory evidence
Template application: Chapters 5, 15 and 16: migration, governance, quality; registers: work_packages, raci, kpis

Name: Venture
Question: How do we sustain, scale, replicate and evolve the transformation?
Definition: The mature, repeatable, sustainable realisation of the original vision.
Guided or delivered by: Institutionalise, sustain, scale, replicate, productise, build ecosystems, innovate
Case outputs: Venture and scale model; operating model; governance; sustainability model; replication playbook; continuous-improvement loop
Template application: Chapters 4 and 18: paperless operating model and the reusable template; feedback loop to the next V1
